svg.title: Wavetable synth — Osc tab (proposal)
svg.desc: The synth window's Osc tab: oscillators A and B with stacked wavetable displays and unison/warp knobs, sub and noise rows, two filters with response curves, the modulation strip of draggable sources, the selected LFO's drawn shape, and an audition keyboard; a drag from LFO 1 onto a knob shows drag-to-assign.
svg.text: click: add · drag: move · Alt-drag: bend · double-click: remove

Proposal mockup — sizes and spacing indicative. Dark plugin window drawn by the editor in RmlUi; wavetable, filter and LFO views are EditorCanvas SubViewports.
